title: WarpAX: Observer-robust energy condition verification for warp drive spacetimes
description: WarpAX uses JAX automatic differentiation to compute exact curvature tensors from analytic warp drive metrics and decides the null, weak, strong and dominant energy conditions over every timelike observer at once, from the positive semidefiniteness of a single 4x4 linear matrix inequality, with a continuous BFGS search over the observer manifold as the independent cross-check. Reported verdicts carry exact rational certificates, and interval branch-and-bound supplies verified continuum enclosures of the worst-case violation.
